leaders.name: Edric of Aldermark
leaders.history: Crowned at nineteen when the old king died, with a court that doubts him and neighbours who remember his father.

leaders.name: Lady Isolde Verdane
leaders.history: Her son died when the old king's tax-men burned Greywald, and she has never forgiven the crown.

leaders.name: Warlord Brannoch Korvath
leaders.history: Took Ironhold by force and holds that the Redscar oath was broken by the Aldermark.

leaders.name: Princess Vesper of Sunmark
leaders.history: Rules Sunmark through ledgers and letters, and prefers a debtor to a corpse.

leaders.name: High Chieftain Haldor
leaders.history: Keeps the scattered Dunmere clans together by repaying every kindness and remembering every raid.

grudges.reason: Your father's tax-men burned Greywald and took her son.
Your father broke the Redscar oath and kept the pass.
Sunmark lent the old king gold that the Aldermark never repaid.
Your father's grain saved the Dunmere clans through a hard winter.
Ironvale raiders shake down Sunmark's caravans.
Distrusts Sunmark's gold and its patience.
Ironvale raiders burned the Dunmere winter camps.
